2137-4642-4785.description:
Cast Awaken the Woods with X equal to 3 by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands you control to their owner's hand, copying Awaken the Woods.
Resolve the copy of Awaken the Woods, creating three 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature tokens.
Activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.
2137-4642-4785.notes: Once you have infinite green mana and infinite land tokens, you may activate Uyo any number of times, targeting any number of instant or sorcery spells.

3263-5147-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
3263-5147-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
3263-5147-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

Repeat from step 1.

Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

Cast Wurmcalling with buyback by paying {2}{G}{G}.
Zaxara triggers, creating two 0/0 Hydra creature tokens.

Faces of the Past trigger twice.

Resolve the second Faces of the Past trigger, untapping all Hydras.
Resolve Wurmcalling, creating a 0/0 Wurm creature token and returning Wurmcalling to your hand.
The Wurm enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
When the Wurm dies, Faces of the Past triggers, either tapping or untapping all Wurms.
Repeat.

2493-2596-2792-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{B}{B}.
2493-2596-2792-5256.description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{B}{B}.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing Archaeomancer and Great Whale, causing target player to mill cards equal to Great Whale and Archaeomancer's power.
Cast Living Death by paying {3}{B}{B}, causing each player to exile all creature cards from their graveyard, sacrifice all creatures they control, then return all cards exiled this way to the battlefield.
Archaeomancer and Great Whale enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Living Death from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands you control.

If the seven lands can tap to produce at least {4}{B}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

Activate the Graveborn token using the ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Graveborn token.
Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Activate Nether Traitor using the ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.

Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Spawning Pit's last ability any number of times.
